substitutions.policy: An alternative can improve candidate coverage, but it cannot be counted as confirmed coverage until every gate passes and the client approves the design change.

client_language.current_truth: 87.5% of placed units currently have confirmed delivery evidence in Spain; 12.5% are confirmed unavailable at the destination; 0% still await live destination refresh.
client_language.unresolved_rule: Percentages never silently normalize away missing evidence; any remainder is shown as route refresh required or unresolved.
client_language.alternative_rule: Similar products are shown beside the design impact and cannot be counted as confirmed coverage until fit, finish, technical, client-approval and destination-delivery gates pass.
client_language.scenario_rule: A conditional scenario may show the supply coverage available after a proposed swap, but it is always separate from current design coverage and never implies approval.
